champion.totalsHead: SHARED PRIOR: total ~ Normal(muTotal=44.9088, sigmaTotal=13.4915), fit 2023-24, no team term — every game on a slate prints the same median total (declared on /nfl since P245).

candidate.form: total ~ Normal(a0 + a1 * s, sigmaC). s = (R_home + R_away)/2 - meanR_train, where R_team is the exponentially decayed walk-forward mean of (points scored + points allowed) per game for that team (initialized at the league mean, REG+POST games only, chronological — strictly pre-game).

fitProtocol.halfLifeSelection: fit a0, a1, sigmaC on 2023 only; score 2024 one-step walk-forward mean NLL; the half-life minimizing it is selected (tie -> longest). Then a0, a1, sigmaC refit once on all 2023-24 with the selected half-life.
fitProtocol.priorForComparison: Normal(muTrain, sigmaTrain) refit on the IDENTICAL 2023-24 REG+POST population — never the committed all-phase numbers — so the comparison is apples to apples.

candidate.whatIsNotAllowed: No selection on 2025; no odds or market totals as inputs; no per-game post-hoc adjustments; the margin head is untouched.

frozenBars.meanNll: candidate mean NLL on held-out 2025 strictly below the refit shared prior's mean NLL on the same games
frozenBars.mae: candidate |total - mean| MAE no worse than the shared prior's MAE * 1.02

reportedDiagnostics: sd of predicted means across 2025 (does the head actually differentiate games), a1 with its train standard error, per-half-life selection trace. Diagnostics are REPORTED, never bars.
decisionRule: ALL bars pass -> the candidate is ELIGIBLE and adoption into the public forecast builder happens as its own reviewed step (coherence guards, regime stamps, artifact regeneration through the workflow). ANY bar fails -> REJECTED; the declared shared prior stands and the /nfl shared-prior disclosure remains exactly as published.
notes: Registered BEFORE implementation; ordering proof is the commit sequence.
